one_sentence_story: Clasping a trusted partner's hand synchronizes brain waves across both skulls and cuts physical pain nearly in half.
so_what_for_you: Your brain budgets energy expecting a friend within arm's reach. Reaching for a trusted hand in hard moments is smart biology, not weakness.

jargon_map.plain: calm eight-to-twelve-beat brain waves for touch

a thermostat tracking how sharp a burn feels inside
a siren that softens when trusted help arrives
